title: ID0417933-DC/Si-D/MC-[ Y2/R9 313202799073 ] Problem with CBID terminal
description:

additional_info.subject: Fluctuating a Emergency Button press alarm
RE: ID0417933-DC/Si-D/MC-[ Y2/R9 313202799073 ] Problem with CBID terminal CRM:02684000072
additional_info.body:
Dear Cedric Schoepff,
I hope this message finds you well.
We have reviewed the logs for the provided timestamp and noticed that the Emergency Button was pressed at that time. To better assist you, could you kindly confirm the following:
Was the Emergency Button pressed and released by someone?
If the Emergency Button was not manually pressed, have you observed any unusual behavior with the button?
If the Emergency Button was not manually pressed, has this issue been occurring recently, or has it been happening for some time? If possible, could you kindly share an approximate date when this issue may have first started?
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
